sources.title: GitHub - Davidup1/URLBERT: Code for the paper - "Continuous Multi-Task Pre-training for Malicious URL Detection and Webpage Classification"
sources.snippet: For the convenience of research in the field of URL analysis, we trained URLBERT, a pre-trained model based on BERT, using a large-scale unlabeled URL dataset. URLBERT is intended for various downstream tasks related to URL analysis.
